hook_text: The water you drank today may once have been in the sea, in a cloud and in a river, and it will travel there again.
clip_script: Durban beach, early morning. The sun warms the Indian Ocean, and invisible water vapour rises, leaving the salt behind. High up, it cools into tiny droplets and makes clouds. The wind blows the clouds inland to the Drakensberg, where rain falls. The rain runs into streams and rivers, past farms and towns, and all the way back to the sea. Evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection. Round and round, for ever.
visual_style: Whiteboard circle diagram: sun over the sea, wavy arrows of evaporation, a cloud forming, rain over mountains, a river flowing back to the sea, each step labelled.
mood: Calm and flowing, like a slow river.
pacing: Follow one drop all the way around the cycle, then repeat it faster with the four labels.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look for the water cycle in action the next time it rains.
